name: Palace Aqueducts
introDiscord:
Elegant aqueducts carry clear water between palace courtyards.

Shizuki appears to have treated the entire royal water system as an
amusement park.
introTwitch:
Elegant aqueducts carry clear water between palace courtyards.

Shizuki appears to have treated the entire royal water system as an
amusement park.

palace-aqueducts-approach.prompt: Palace Aqueducts opens into three routes through the drowned kingdom.

left.message:
A crystal fountain pours into an old bath channel.

Shizuki wrote:

'Royal water slide candidate #1.

Too shallow.

Research continues.'
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message:
A Palace Lamprey shoots from the aqueduct.

Apparently something already lives in the slide.

forward.message:
An old maintenance alcove hides a royal service coffer filled with
Star Candies.

palace-aqueducts-depths.prompt: Deeper within Palace Aqueducts, three paths wind through the abandoned royal district.

left.message:
One Berry rests inside a little floating cup.

Shizuki's note:

'Water slide candidate #4.

Glimmer completed route in six seconds.

Glimmer can fly.

RESULT INVALID.'

right.message: A tiled basin conceals a waterproof palace coffer.

forward.message:
A Palace Lamprey races down the aqueduct directly toward you.

Water attraction officially closed.

palace-aqueducts-threshold.prompt: Near Royal Bloodwell, three final approaches lead onward.

left.message: A Lamprey coils inside an ornate fountain basin.

right.message:
Restorative mineral water bubbles beneath a royal lion spout.

Shizuki rated it:

'Water slide: 2/10.

Healing fountain: 9/10.

Lion: excellent.'
right.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

forward.message: Star Candies glitter beneath the palace waterwheel.

boss-antechamber.name: Royal Bloodwell
boss-antechamber.prompt: The aqueducts empty into Royal Bloodwell.

bossPromptDiscord:
The aqueducts empty into Royal Bloodwell.

Something enormous circles beneath the red palace stone.

Use /yes to enter the Bloodwell, or /no to retire from
royal water-slide research.
bossPromptTwitch:
The aqueducts empty into Royal Bloodwell.

Something enormous circles beneath the red palace stone.

Use !yes to enter the Bloodwell, or !no to retire from
royal water-slide research.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Royal Bloodwell. The royal challenge will wait.

boss.revealText:
An enormous Lamprey erupts through the fountain channels.

Crimson Court Lamprey reveals itself!

completionText:
The palace water begins flowing normally again.

Shizuki's final aqueduct note:

'Slide project cancelled.

Glimmer refuses to accept ruling.'
